text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Today's a great day too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the holiday! I'm completely refreshed, and after eating my favorite bento, I'm fully fired up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Why don't you try some
local Kyoto inari bento too!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When you need an energy boost, this is the best!
It's simple, delicious, and never gets old—I highly recommend it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl ate her favorite boxed lunch
and thoroughly enjoyed her day off.
